prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity visual direction preview, actual playable desktop web game UI, landscape 1440 x 1000 proportions.
Primary request: Design a distinctive polished Signal Lock single-laptop solo rehearsal screen in a "Pocket theatre" direction. The game uses animal, colour, and accessory rotary controls to match a simulated audience target. This is a real usable game interface screenshot, not a poster or marketing page.
Composition: edge-to-edge app with deep warm ink #24231F background. Slim top masthead: "SIGNAL LOCK" left, "SOLO REHEARSAL" center, "ROUND 03" right. A cream cue strip directly below reads "OPEN  >  FIVE VOTERS  >  FROZEN  >  RESULT" with FROZEN highlighted vermilion. Dominant wide two-character stage fills middle 58% of screen, two large distinct lit matte articulated geometric 3D toy puppets, code-buildable using spheres, cylinders, simple polygons and hinged limbs. Left heading "TARGET", a green frog wearing a simple gold crown. Right heading "YOUR SIGNAL", a blue fox wearing chunky dark headphones. Keep target and current output equally legible. Below each animal provide three concise visible attribute labels: left "FROG / GREEN / CROWN", right "FOX / BLUE / HEADPHONES". Between characters, at upper middle of stage, huge warm cream "04" countdown with small "FROZEN" and "Match before time runs out". Matte, physically plausible soft shadowing confined to the characters, no gradient background.
At bottom a cream #F2E8D5 physical control console, about 28% height, full width. Three generously sized sculpted rotary knobs in a row with precise warm theatre cue typography. Label above each "ANIMAL", "COLOUR", "ACCESSORY", current selection beneath "Fox", "Blue", "Headphones". Keyboard hint pairs "A  D", "J  L", "←  →" displayed as small keycaps beneath corresponding knob. Sculpted ivory controls with vermilion index ticks and tactile concentric bevel edges, dark marks at discrete positions. Knobs have comfortable spacing and convincing interaction affordance. A clear small vermilion "Ⅱ Pause" primary game action at bottom right of console, with secondary "Messages" text button. Preserve legibility, no overlapping labels or cropped controls.
Very small secondary horizontal simulated voter strips between stage and bottom console: three categories labeled "ANIMAL · 20 SIMULATED", "COLOUR · 20 SIMULATED", "ACCESSORY · 20 SIMULATED", each with twenty compact segmented marks. Restrained mint #AED8B6 and vermilion #F16B46 accents. Thin rules instead of cards. Warm personality via strong rounded editorial title lettering and precise condensed theatre cue labels. Dramatic quiet negative space around the characters, tactile warm objects, exceptional composition. The UI must be clear and plausible to implement in React / Three.js.
Avoid: browser chrome, phone mockup, laptop frame, landing page, promotional copy, elaborate organic fur or feathers, decorative puppet strings, gradients, glass cards, glowing neon, purple, generic dashboard panels, excessive rounded cards, unreadable tiny lettering, extra animals. Render exact requested text cleanly.
